title: Create Engagement Task
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-13
html:
Path: /customer_engagement/202412/engagement_tasks

Method: [POST]

Function Description

Create an engagement task that acts as a container for grouping messages with similar content and rules, allowing sellers to track and compare task performance across different types of content. Note that each task has a mandatory end time, and once expired, it cannot be used to send additional messages.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.
idempotency_key string Y 372dd4e7-9c02-4db0-a14b-0b23ce54e142 A unique key to recognize a request and prevent duplicate processing of the same request, especially in cases of connection issues. Ensure this key is unique for each request to avoid accidental duplicates.
Note: We recommend that you generate v4 UUIDs for use as keys.

Request Body Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
template_id string Y 50002_20011 The ID of engagement message templates predefined by TikTok Shop. Retrieve the value from Get Message Templates.
task_name string Y Task1 for mega sale The name of the task. Length: 1–256 bytes.
end_time int Y 1744344885 The time at which the task ends, and messages will no longer be sent. Unix timestamp (seconds).
channel string Y TIKTOK_IM The engagement channel. Only TIKTOK_IM is supported.
product_ids []string N [8646958016719848812] The product ID. Retrieve this value from the Search Products API.
coupon_ids []string N [8646958016719848812] The coupon ID. Retrieve this value and other coupon-related information from the Search Coupons API.
Note: The coupon properties must comply with the rules defined in coupon_card_rules.coupon_type of the Get Message Templates API.
